mapper.sql: select b.baby_id, b.baby_name, b.nickname, b.gender, b.birth_date, b.birth_weight_kg, b.birth_height_cm, b.birth_head_cm, b.mom_user_id, b.mom_user_name, b.media_dir, b.status, b.del_flag, b.rev, b.create_by, b.create_time, b.update_by, b.update_time, b.remark from nc_baby b
mapper.select:
inner join nc_baby_member m on m.baby_id = b.baby_id and m.user_id = #{queryUserId} and m.status = '0'
b.del_flag = '0'
and b.baby_name like concat('%', #{babyName}, '%')
and b.mom_user_name like concat('%', #{momUserName}, '%')
and b.status = #{status}
order by b.baby_id desc
mapper.update:
update nc_baby
baby_name = #{babyName}, nickname = #{nickname}, gender = #{gender}, birth_date = #{birthDate}, birth_weight_kg = #{birthWeightKg}, birth_height_cm = #{birthHeightCm}, birth_head_cm = #{birthHeadCm}, status = #{status}, update_by = #{updateBy}, remark = #{remark}, rev = rev + 1, update_time = current_timestamp
where baby_id = #{babyId} and del_flag = '0'
update nc_baby set media_dir = #{mediaDir} where baby_id = #{babyId}
mapper.select: select role_id from sys_role where role_key = #{roleKey} and del_flag = '0' limit 1
select count(1) from sys_user_role ur inner join sys_role r on r.role_id = ur.role_id and r.del_flag = '0' where ur.user_id = #{userId} and r.role_key = #{roleKey}
